summary: We developed a storybook entitled A Chapter That Never Closed, which tells the story of a young boy exploring the jungle alongside the journey of NASA's Mars Exploration Rover, Sojourner. Our storybook addresses the challenge "Abandoned but Not Forgotten" by highlighting Sojourner's journey, challenges and remarkable discoveries on Mars. It reminds readers that although the rover is no longer active, its contributions to space exploration remain valuable and meaningful. This project is important because it raises awareness about NASA's Mars exploration while teaching readers that even the smallest explorers can make a significant difference. It also emphasizes that although a journey may end, its story and legacy will never be forgotten.
details: It works to let people know that no matter how old you are as long as you have been so good and bring benefit to the world, you will never be forgotten. In this project we're using canva, chat gpt for more information and idea for out storybook, dola ai to generate video abt mars hardware. Our project can give people motivation to be more passion in life even in their down situation. Many people think that once you're retired you are done but my team thinks that it's wrong, because we're still following the path of the people that used to be so good in life. And that's why we put the title "A Chapter That Never Closed" in our story book. So as the Mars hardware it was already abandoned but people still can know it's existence by dicovering.
